content:
## GTA 6 Trophy Count and Full Completion Time Leaks in New Reports

As anticipation builds for the next installment in Rockstar Games' iconic franchise, new reports continue to shed light on what players can expect from the game's depth and scale. According to a recent report by media outlet Polygon, completionists aiming for a 100% run in Grand Theft Auto 6 are in for a massive and demanding time investment.

### The Challenge of Animal Studies and RNG Achievements

Based on the report from Polygon, achieving a true 100% completion in GTA 6 will not be a walk in the park. The publication notes that the game features specific hurdles, including animal studies and RNG-based (random number generation) achievements. 

These design choices suggest that players looking to check off every single box in the game will need to go beyond standard map exploration. Dealing with RNG-based drops or events and thoroughly studying the in-game wildlife will likely demand both patience and strategic repetition. Rockstar Games has previously experimented with intricate completion requirements in titles like Red Dead Redemption 2, and it appears this design philosophy is carrying over to the streets of Vice City and its surrounding regions.

### Hundreds of Hours for Completionists

Because of these complex achievement requirements, Polygon reports that completionists will have to spend **hundreds of hours** in Grand Theft Auto 6 to fully complete the game. While the main story campaign length often appeals to a broad audience, the dedication required to secure every trophy and complete every hidden objective is clearly tailored for the most dedicated fans of the franchise.

### Editor's Take

Polygon's report paints a picture of a game built with immense longevity in mind. While hundreds of hours of content is a dream for hardcore completionists looking to maximize their value, the inclusion of RNG-based achievements and animal studies might test the patience of casual trophy hunters. As always, keep in mind that unconfirmed game details are subject to change until Rockstar Games reveals the official trophy list.
